configuration.query: Give me the list of current open opportunities for Adventure Works
configuration.rephrase: The query will join opportunity to account, list out opportunities where status is open and parent account named 'Adventure works'
configuration.standardsql: SELECT [opportunity].* FROM [opportunity] JOIN [account] ON [opportunity].[parentaccountid] = [account].[accountid] WHERE [opportunity].[stateCode] = 'Open' AND [account].[name] = 'Adventure works'
